title: events/types/retry.iteration.completed
description: Payload for event_type 'retry.iteration.completed' (native type, feature 003; FR-205): per-window verdict. verdict 'passed' ends the loop early_exit; 'failed' leads to mutate+reload or exhaustion; 'aborted' marks a window cut short by a bridge/budget/state failure.

gate_passed.description: Gate verdict for this window; false for aborted windows.

mutation_id.description: Mutation applied before this window; null on the initial attempt.

tick_end.description: Observed tick at window end; null when the window aborted before status could be read.
